data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that hides or shows any child when the user scrolls.
data.what_it_does: A small Flutter widget for hiding or showing any child (like navigation bars or headers) when the user scrolls. It supports vertical and horizontal hide animations, manual controls via a controller, and route-pop restoration.
use_when: You want to hide a bottom navigation bar or header on reverse scroll and show it on forward scroll.
You need vertical or horizontal hide animations bound to a ScrollController.
You want to manually control visibility or restore state on route pop.
avoid_when: You are not using a scrollable widget with a ScrollController.
You need a complex layout system unrelated to scroll-driven visibility.
strengths: Supports both vertical and horizontal hide directions.
Provides a ScrollToHideController for manual show, hide, toggle, and state reads.
Includes optional RouteObserver support to restore visibility when returning from a pushed route.
weaknesses: Requires sharing the exact ScrollController attached to the scrollable.
Manual height or width sizing may be required for stable shown dimensions.
